description: Draw a spiral (Spiral tool, with its dialog's options): radius from the centre to the outermost point, decay (each quarter-turn segment's radius as a percentage of the one before), segments (quarter turns; four make one wind) and style (direction). It starts at its outermost point, to the right of the centre, and winds inward

artboardIndex.description: Artboard index (0-based). Positions are measured from this artboard's top-left corner. Default 0

fill.description: Fill. A swatch name, "#RRGGBB", "rgb(r,g,b)" (0-255), "cmyk(c,m,y,k)" (0-100), "gray(g)" (0-100, 100 = black) or "none"

layer.description: Layer to draw on. Default: the active layer

name.description: Name for the new item (shown in the Layers panel)

radius.description: Points from the centre to the outermost point

stroke.description: Stroke colour. A swatch name, "#RRGGBB", "rgb(r,g,b)" (0-255), "cmyk(c,m,y,k)" (0-100), "gray(g)" (0-100, 100 = black) or "none"

style.description: Direction the spiral winds in from its outer end. Default counterclockwise

name: create_spiral
title: Create Spiral
